div.h1: A day worth looking forward to.
div.p: Choose your parks and rides. Confirm your entry time, make room for the transfer, and keep an alternate ready.
Local-only saving requires JavaScript. Apply your selections to run the research.

Enter the official entry time you can actually use. Eligibility is recorded, not verified. The first-park window starts at your entered time; it is not shifted automatically for early entry. Date filters match historical weekdays, not future weather or holiday demand.

Transfer timing assumes both parks share a timezone. Priorities are a shortlist, not a walking route or a guaranteed ride sequence. Party notes and commitments are reminders, not automatically enforced constraints. Refresh research after loading or changing a saved trip.

search.query: `queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$morning|s$ | eval visit_day=strptime($visit_date|s$,"%Y-%m-%d"), selected_weekday=strftime(visit_day,"%w"), observed_weekday=strftime(strptime(park_local_date,"%Y-%m-%d"),"%w") | where observed_weekday=selected_weekday | `queue_times_observed_day` | where complete_day=1 | eval local_minute=tonumber(park_local_hour)*60+tonumber(substr(park_local_time,15,2)), entry_minute=tonumber(substr($entry_time|s$,1,2))*60+tonumber(substr($entry_time|s$,4,2)), leave_minute=tonumber(substr($leave_time|s$,1,2))*60+tonumber(substr($leave_time|s$,4,2)), arrival_minute=leave_minute+tonumber($transfer|s$) | where match($entry_time|s$,"^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$") AND match($leave_time|s$,"^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$") AND leave_minute>entry_minute AND arrival_minute<1440 | eval shortlist=split($morning_rides|s$,",") | where mvfind(shortlist,"^[*]$")>=0 OR mvfind(shortlist,"^".tostring(ride_id)."$")>=0 | eval early_wait=if(open=1 AND local_minute>=entry_minute AND local_minute<entry_minute+30,wait_time,null()),later_wait=if(open=1 AND local_minute>=entry_minute+30 AND local_minute<leave_minute,wait_time,null()),early_open=if(local_minute>=entry_minute AND local_minute<entry_minute+30,100*open,null()) | stats median(early_wait) as early median(later_wait) as later avg(early_open) as availability count(early_wait) as early_samples by park_name ride_name park_local_date | where isnotnull(early) AND isnotnull(later) AND early_samples>=2 | eval advantage=later-early | stats median(early) as Early_minutes median(later) as Later_minutes median(advantage) as Potential_minutes_avoided min(advantage) as Smallest_daily_advantage max(advantage) as Largest_daily_advantage avg(availability) as Early_open_pct count as Days by park_name ride_name | where Days>=tonumber($days|s$) | eval Early_open_pct=round(Early_open_pct,1) | sort 0 - Potential_minutes_avoided Early_minutes | table park_name ride_name Early_minutes Later_minutes Potential_minutes_avoided Smallest_daily_advantage Largest_daily_advantage Early_open_pct Days | appendpipe [stats count | where count=0 | eval Status="No qualifying evidence. Check times, date, shortlist and minimum days; use exploratory mode for sparse history." | fields Status]
